title: One-Step Image Translation with Text-to-Image Models (CycleGAN-Turbo)
mechanism: One-step SD-Turbo generator with LoRA and encoder-decoder skip connections trained with cycle and adversarial losses on unpaired domains; skips keep the input structure.
adaptation: Domain A = 478 train cells plus existing synthetic half-cut views; domain B = 1,152 half-cut multi pool cells plus scuffed CSIR cells. Translate train cells to B style and keep real labels; 1-ch replicated to 3. Latent 64x64 may erase low-contrast cracks, so drop samples where house-ensemble crack relF1@2 on the translated cell falls below 0.9 of the source value.
min_experiment: PF + 478 translated cells vs PF, 5 seeds. Metric E1 crack relF1@2 and E1 inactive IoU, guard clean-49 crack IoU. Kill: both E1 gains < +0.03 or test crack IoU drop > 0.01. About 25 GPU-h.
evidence: R: beats GAN and diffusion translators on day/night and weather translation (FID, structure preservation); 193 citations; no segmentation-on-translated numbers.
prior_overlap: Synthetic half-cut views (geometry only) were n.d.; appearance translation toward half-cut/scuff style never run. Open.
